args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST

ESSENTIALS:
- Passport/ID
- Travel documents
- Cash and credit cards
- Sunglasses and sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Hat or cap
- Beach towel
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach bag

CLOTHING:
- Light, breathable clothing (cotton, linen)
- Swimwear
- Cover-ups
- Light jacket or cardigan (for air-conditioned spaces)
- Rain jacket or poncho (for sudden showers)
- Underwear and socks
- Evening wear (if going out)

TOILETRIES:
- Sunscreen (reapply frequently)
- After-sun lotion
- Insect repellent
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Deodorant
- Razor and shaving cream
- Hairbrush/comb
- Hair ties
- Makeup and toiletries
- Hand sanitizer
- Wet wipes
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit

ELECTRONICS:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power bank
- Headphones
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Portable speaker

BEACH ACCESSORIES:
- Beach umbrella or tent
- Snorkeling gear (if available)
- Water bottle
- Beach games (frisbee, volleyball)
- Cooler with ice packs
- Waterproof phone case

OTHER ITEMS:
- Beach blanket
- Book or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask
- Earplugs
- Travel-sized laundry detergent
- Laundry bag
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel-sized hand sanitizer
- Ziploc bags (various sizes)
- Travel sewing kit
- Small scissors
- Hand cream
- Lip balm with SPF

HAWAII-SPECIFIC:
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Water shoes (for rocky areas)
- Waterproof phone case
- Waterproof bag for electronics
- Snorkeling mask (if not bringing gear)
- Waterproof camera case

EMERGENCY CONTACTS:
- Hotel information
- Emergency contacts
- Travel insurance information
- Local emergency numbers

ENJOY YOUR HAWAII VACATION!
